meta.region: Carroll County and the north Baltimore orbit

weather.note: SAMPLE weather, not a live NWS forecast: early fall around Sep 29, 2026 looks mild. Turn on Rainy-day boost to pretend the outdoor half is a wash.

meta.disclaimer: Fixture catalog for local demo. Public star counts are sample figures for ranking, not live Google or Yelp data. SAMPLE badges are fictional rows.

items.ageFit: Babies through early elementary; storytimes vary by week
items.name: CCPL Finksburg Library
items.why: Home-base Carroll library. Read and Play (birth–2) on Tuesday mornings in October; calm indoor backup when the weather turns.

items.ageFit: Birth–2
items.name: CCPL Read and Play (Finksburg)
items.why: Interactive books, rhymes, music, and a short playgroup. Birth–2. Free; no ticket.

items.ageFit: Stroller-friendly market browse; confirm field rules if picking
items.name: Carolyn Farm & Orchard Market
items.why: On-farm market in Finksburg — seasonal fruit, plants, cider, decor. Ultra-local. Hours and any PYO need a phone check.

items.ageFit: Verify highchair / kids options
items.name: Bistro 91 Finksburg
items.why: Local Italian a few minutes from 21048. Fine for an early family dinner or a later night out — call about highchairs.

items.ageFit: Daytime with room to wander; stay with kids
items.weatherNote: Outdoor picnic vibe — have an indoor backup if it rains.
items.name: Farmacy Brewing
items.why: Horse-farm brewery in Reisterstown. Pastures and picnic tables; explicitly kid-friendly in daylight. No pets (working farm). Pack a picnic.

items.ageFit: Toddler storytimes; all ages welcome in the branch
items.name: BCPL Reisterstown
items.why: Baltimore County branch with toddler storytimes. Open Sunday afternoons — useful when Carroll branches are dark.

items.ageFit: Kids’ menu; easy in-and-out
items.name: Maggie’s Restaurant
items.why: Casual American in Westminster with a kids’ menu. Reliable family default after a market or maze morning.

items.ageFit: Easy morning stroll with a stroller
items.name: Downtown Westminster Farmers Market
items.why: Saturday produce stroll at the Conaway lot on Railroad Avenue. Stroller-friendly. Free to browse; pay for what you take.

items.ageFit: All ages
items.name: CCPL Westminster
items.why: Downtown Westminster branch. Indoor backup after Main Street, or a rainy swap for the farmers market.

items.ageFit: Family tables; classic after-orchard meal
items.name: Baugher’s Restaurant
items.why: Farm-restaurant comfort food in the Westminster orbit. Natural stop after the orchard. Hours often run long — still verify.

items.ageFit: Family Mexican
items.name: Papa Joe’s
items.why: Family Mexican in Westminster. Kids’ meals commonly on the menu. Confirm highchairs if you need one.

items.ageFit: Early dinner more than a late taproom
items.name: Brewery Fire Taphouse
items.why: Local beers and a sit-down taphouse pace in Westminster. Better early with a calm kid than late. Verify the room day-of.

items.ageFit: Daytime patio; livelier at night
items.name: Pub Dog Westminster
items.why: Pizza, house beer, and a large outdoor beer garden. Easy Westminster afternoon. Dogs outside.

items.ageFit: All ages; best as a morning stroll
items.weatherNote: Mostly outdoor aisles; marketplace next door is indoor.
items.name: Carroll County Farmers Market — Celebrating Fall
items.why: Apples, mums, pumpkins, crafts, and cafeteria breakfast. Same Ag Center campus as the corn maze later and Fall Marketplace indoors. Stroller-friendly if you go early.
items.address: Carroll County Agriculture Center, Westminster, MD

items.ageFit: Indoor browse; stroller OK in the arena aisles
items.name: Fall Marketplace MD
items.why: Craft and direct-sale vendors inside Shipley Arena on the Ag Center campus. Indoor add-on to Celebrating Fall the same morning.

items.ageFit: Ages 4 & under free; maze can be long for toddlers — carriers help
items.weatherNote: Outdoor. Cash only — ATMs are not the plan.
items.name: Carroll County Ag Center Corn Maze
items.why: Local corn maze on the Ag Center grounds. Cash only. Under 4 free. Last tickets about an hour before close.
items.whenHours: Fri 6–10 PM; Sat 2–10 PM; Sun 12–6 PM · Sep 18–Nov 1, 2026

items.ageFit: Market is stroller-friendly; picking fields are not
items.weatherNote: Fields are outdoor. Market building is a short backup.
items.name: Baugher’s At The Farm
items.why: Quieter orchard counterpoint to the festival campus. PYO apples and the market. No strollers or bags in the PYO fields — leave them at the market and use a wagon.
items.whenHours: Market Tue–Sun 9–6 (closed Mon). PYO apples often Thu–Sun 9–5 — verify hotline 410-857-0111

items.ageFit: Little kids on the paved loop; longer trails want a carrier
items.weatherNote: Discovery Room is the rainy-day half.
items.name: Hashawha / Bear Branch Nature Center
items.why: Playground and paved trail by the center, plus a Discovery Room indoors. Hybrid stop: short outside, dry inside.
items.whenHours: Grounds daylight; center hours vary — verify

items.ageFit: Short lakeside walks
items.name: Piney Run Park
items.why: Lake, short shore walks, playgrounds near the west side, and a nature center. Better for a short visit than a long hike with little kids. County fees may apply.
items.costVibe: County park fee may apply — verify
items.whenHours: Typical season Mar 1–Nov 30, 7 AM–sunset — verify off-season

items.ageFit: Stroller-friendly Sunday stroll
items.name: Downtown Sykesville Farmers Market
items.why: Sunday produce on Main Street / Baldwin Drive. Small downtown pocket, easy with a stroller.
items.address: Baldwin Drive & Main Street, Sykesville, MD 21784

items.ageFit: Family street festival
items.name: Sykesville Main Street Fall Festival
items.why: Autumn Around the World: crafts, games, animals, face painting. Rain or shine. No pets.

items.ageFit: Programs often ages 3–6; branch is all ages
items.name: CCPL Eldersburg
items.why: South Carroll branch. Little Adventures and other kids’ programs. Solid rainy-day swap for Piney Run.

items.ageFit: Daytime patio with kids; under-21 rules apply later
items.name: 1623 Brewing
items.why: Taproom and patio in the Eldersburg / Sykesville orbit. Food trucks. Family visitors mention a changing station. Verify the current site.

items.ageFit: Playground ages; paved paths for strollers
items.weatherNote: Outdoor playground. Pair with Irvine or a library if it rains.
items.name: Northwest Regional Park
items.why: Owings Mills destination playground (Ravens-themed), paved paths, story trail, pavilions. Stroller-friendly pavement. Splash pad was still a later project — playground is the draw.
items.address: 4515 Deer Park Rd, Owings Mills, MD 21117

items.ageFit: Toddler storytimes
items.name: BCPL Owings Mills
items.why: Large branch next to the Owings Mills orbit. Toddler storytimes and a real indoor backup for the regional park.
items.address: 10302 Grand Central Ave, Owings Mills, MD 21117

items.ageFit: Under 5 free; nature play outside and exhibits inside
items.weatherNote: Exhibit hall covers a rainy visit.
items.name: Irvine Nature Center
items.why: Live animals indoors plus an outdoor classroom and trails in Owings Mills. No dogs. Kids 5 and under free; $5 ages 6+.
items.address: 11201 Garrison Forest Rd, Owings Mills, MD 21117

items.ageFit: Costume night for little kids
items.name: CandyFEST at Bridgeway
items.why: Free family Halloween night in Owings Mills / Reisterstown: candy (including allergy-sensitive options), games, inflatables. No registration.
items.address: 11301 Red Run Blvd, Owings Mills, MD 21117

items.ageFit: Under 12 with an adult; under 2 free
items.weatherNote: Outdoor activity park. Verify rain plans on the site.
items.name: Cornfusion at Showvaker’s
items.why: Weekend farm activity park in Manchester: maze, patch, games. Armband for ages 3+. Under 2 free. A dedicated outing, not a quick stop.
items.whenHours: Sat–Sun 10 AM–6 PM through Oct 25, 2026 (last armband 5 PM)

items.ageFit: Nature play for little kids; Marble Quarry Loop is the shorter walk
items.weatherNote: Center exhibits are the indoor half of a trail day.
items.name: Oregon Ridge Nature Center
items.why: Indoor exhibits and live animals, a nature play space, tot lot, storybook trail, and longer loops. Trash-free park — pack out what you bring.
items.costVibe: Free park and center (programs may fee)

items.ageFit: Family nature fest
items.name: Honey Harvest Festival
items.why: Honey extraction, wildlife, vendors, and fall arts at Oregon Ridge. Park shuttle from the lodge.

items.ageFit: Short costume walk
items.name: Tricks and Treats on the Ridge
items.why: Costume walk about half a mile for nature-themed treats. Bring a bag. Advance registration required.

items.ageFit: Quiet daytime; kids must stay supervised
items.name: Serpent Ridge Vineyard
items.why: Boutique vineyard west of Westminster: lawn, pavilion, covered patio. Kids allowed under supervision. BYO snacks. No balls or frisbees. Confirm the street address on the site before you navigate.
items.address: Westminster, MD — confirm street address on serpentridge.com

items.ageFit: Community fest — confirm kid activities day-of
items.name: Hampstead Fall Festival
items.why: Main Street community fall fest at the war memorial park. Rain or shine. Kid-activity detail should be checked the week of.
items.address: Hampstead War Memorial Park, 1215 Main St, Hampstead, MD 21074

items.ageFit: Birth–8 for several programs
items.name: CCPL North Carroll (Hampstead)
items.why: Hampstead branch. Family Fun Night and storytimes. Indoor backup for the fall festival weekend.

items.ageFit: Kids 12 & under free admission; rides cost extra
items.name: Das Best Pumpkin Fest
items.why: Pumpkin drop, carousel and Ferris wheel, petting zoo, hay maze at the Maryland State Fairgrounds infield. Kids 12 and under free admission; rides extra. No outside food (water and formula OK).
items.costVibe: $10 adult · kids 12 & under free · ride tickets extra

items.ageFit: Explicit kids’ corner; daytime is the fit
items.name: B.C. Brewery
items.why: Hunt Valley taproom with a kids’ corner (blocks, books, chalkboard). Stay with kids. Under 21 not past 9 PM. Food on site.

items.ageFit: Classic fall outing; tickets required before you go
items.name: Weber’s Fall Harvest Days
items.why: Pumpkins, cider donuts, hayrides, and Pumpkinland in Parkville. Advance online tickets — not sold on site. Farther east than Carroll, still inside a 25–40 mile look.
items.costVibe: Advance online tickets only (not sold on site)
items.whenHours: Season through ~Nov 8, 2026 · hours vary — verify day-of

items.ageFit: Park festival
items.name: Fall Harvest and Arts Festival
items.why: Harvest and arts day at Cromwell Valley Park. Confirm the entrance on the county page before you drive — the park has more than one.
items.address: Cromwell Valley Park, Baltimore County, MD

items.ageFit: Stroller-friendly paths; crowds on event weekends
items.weatherNote: Mix of outdoor paths and some indoor buildings.
items.name: Zoo BOO! at The Maryland Zoo
items.why: Costume trick-or-treat inside the zoo. Exceptional, not a weekly Carroll stop — farther and more crowded. Included when you widen the radius.

items.ageFit: Not-too-scary kid focus
items.name: Spooky Saturday (Westminster)
items.why: City kids’ Halloween: costumes, trick-or-treat, crafts. 2026 materials disagree on Wakefield Valley Park vs downtown Main Street — verify the location before you go.
items.address: Verify: Wakefield Valley Park, 1000 Fenby Farm Rd, or downtown Main Street

items.ageFit: Adult-leaning; under 12 free on GA
items.name: Westminster Oyster Stroll
items.why: Oysters, music, and yard games in downtown Westminster. Guests 12 and under free on general admission, but this is an adult tasting more than a kids’ festival.

items.ageFit: Costume add-on to the maze
items.name: Trunk or Treat at the Ag Center Maze
items.why: Costume trunk-or-treat beside the corn maze. Ages 15 and under get a small maze discount with a costume. Maze admission is cash.
items.costVibe: Maze admission (cash) · costume discount for 15 & under

items.ageFit: Stroller possible; stamina and crowds are the limit
items.weatherNote: Outdoor fair. Farther than the north-Baltimore orbit.
items.name: Maryland Renaissance Festival
items.why: Village fair at Revel Grove in Crownsville. A spectacle, also a long drive and a crowd. Only shows up when the radius reaches it — outside a normal 25-mile Finksburg search.
items.whenHours: Weekends 10 AM–7 PM through Sun Oct 25, 2026
